note: Franklin County GA publishes its zoning map only as static PDFs (2022 approved map, draft UDC map, 2005 map); no ArcGIS REST zoning service or interactive viewer found. The Franklin County open-data hub (data-franklincova.opendata.arcgis.com) is Franklin County, Virginia. Cities (Lavonia, Royston) publish zoning only as PDF maps or via commercial parcel data; no queryable district layer found.
